_comment: One per client: sites/<slug>/site.json. NO secrets in this file - keys, passwords and tokens go in your own store: scripts/wpu-secret.ps1 set <slug> key | adminpass | sftp_pass | cpanel_token.
name: Client name
user: wp-admin login (password goes in the secret store as adminpass; only needed for install-bridge and admin audits)

hosting._comment: Emergency access when WordPress is down (/wpu:rescue). NO passwords or tokens here: wpu-secret.ps1 set <slug> sftp_pass | sftp_keypass | cpanel_token. Delete the parts the host does not offer.

host: e.g. Hostinger / WP Engine / Kinsta / SiteGround - and its quirks
_local_only: Fill these only when the site runs in LocalWP (scripts/detect.ps1 does it for you):
